title: Competitions
summary: Prepare an agentic AI team for Mad Chairs Tournament 2026, an open Kaggle competition associated with IEEE SSCI 2027.

heroImage.alt: A friendly robot mediating a group activity with children in a sunny green park

sections.heading: Mad Chairs Tournament 2026
paragraphs: Robots and AI will need social norms for dividing scarce resources, such as space in traffic and attention on social media. You can advance potential norms by preparing agentic AI to win this 3 vs 3 game on Kaggle.

This competition will remain active and open to all until 24 December 2026. IEEE SSCI 2027 will include an awards ceremony to honor the winners. Further details, rules, data, evaluation criteria, and submission instructions are available on the Kaggle competition page.

cards.title: Join the Competition on Kaggle
cards.text: Review the rules and enter Mad Chairs Tournament 2026. Open to all until 24 December 2026.
